description: Earthquakes within a radius of coordinates, a US ZIP code or a US town, over the last 1-365 days, newest first, each with its distance, plus the largest in the window. Data: USGS, as held by QuakeIndex. Each result includes its source, when the data was last confirmed, and links to the QuakeIndex and USGS event pages. No predictions and no warnings: results name ShakeAlert and MyShake as the sources of earthquake early warning.

city.description: US town or city, e.g. 'Ridgecrest'. Add state.

latitude.description: Decimal degrees. Give with longitude, OR use zip, OR city.

state.description: Two-letter code or name, with city.

name: earthquakes_near
title: Earthquakes near a place
